description: In front of the hands on the bed are a green plate and a set of toy sandwich ingredients like bread, lettuce, tomato, onion rings, cheese, cucumber slices, and an egg. The right hand moves in from the right to pick up and place ingredients onto the bread on the green plate, stacking lettuce, tomato, onion, a patty, egg, cucumbers, and cheese, then sets the top bun down to close the sandwich while the left hand stays nearby to steady the plate and items.
